name: call-chip

frames.best_why: The bash chip is mid-run with a 2205 ms timer while the edit chip below also counts up, showing the live state.

tagline: Compact tool-call chip with a live timer and a progress wash.
summary: A small inline chip naming an agent's tool call, its argument and an elapsed time. A translucent wash fills across the bar while it runs, then it turns green with a tick when done or red with a retry on failure.
appearance: A stack of narrow dark rounded bars, each holding a tiny monochrome icon, a short bold tool name, a monospace argument and a right-aligned timer. Faint lighter fills sit inside the bars, and the rows are tightly stacked.
behaviour: While a chip runs, a translucent wash creeps across its width toward the timer, which counts up in milliseconds. On completion the wash turns green and the icon rolls to a tick; on failure it turns red and the whole chip shakes.
demo_content: Tool calls grep "TODO" src/, read src/app/checkout.tsx, bash npm run test -- --ci and edit src/lib/cart.ts.
search_phrases: terminal command that shows elapsed time
loading pill for a function call
small status bar for ai tools
task row with success and error states
use_when: An agent interface should show which tool is running, what it is doing and how long it takes.
avoid_when: The text is tiny and muted on a dark surface, and the timer needs a wide row to avoid crowding.
customise: Props set the icon, tool name, argument, status, expected duration, size, colours, wash opacity, shake, timer visibility and a retry callback.
weight_why: A few chips; only the timer runs a frame loop, and only while a chip is running.

a11y.note: Status is announced and retry is a real button, but that button has no visible focus and the chip text is hidden from readers.

issues: The tool name, argument and timer are hidden from screen readers; only a composed status sentence is read.
polish_why: Clean chip with a nice progress wash; tiny muted text and near-identical frames.
title: Call Chip
